name: Fukuchiyama (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Fukuchiyama city emblem in yellow: an outlined six-pointed star of two triangles enclosing a small triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Fukuchiyama, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 March 1983; the emblem dates from 1 December 1938.

features.role: Fukuchiyama city emblem — an outlined six-pointed star of two triangles enclosing a small triangle
